knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
com_other <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Commercial  Industial Report.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
com_fuel <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Commercial Fuel Type.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
condo_other <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Condo Report.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
condo_fuel <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Condo Fuel Type.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_other <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Report Residential.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_fuel <- read_csv(here("Groton", "Residential Fuel Type.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
com_other <- com_other %>%
  select(Location, Primary_Use, Stories, Living_AreaGBA) %>%
  rename(USECODE = Primary_Use, STORYHEIGHT = Stories, AREASQ = Living_AreaGBA) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(cumsum = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("Location", Location, cumsum, sep = "_")

com_fuel <- com_fuel %>%
  select(Location, Usrfld_207_Desc) %>%
  rename(FUELTYPE = Usrfld_207_Desc) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(cumsum = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("Location", Location, cumsum, sep = "_")

condo_other <- condo_other %>%
  select(Location, Primary_Use, Stories, Living_AreaGBA) %>%
  rename(USECODE = Primary_Use, STORYHEIGHT = Stories, AREASQ = Living_AreaGBA) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(cumsum = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("Location", Location, cumsum, sep = "_")

condo_fuel <- condo_fuel %>%
  select(Location, Heat_Sys_Desc) %>%
  rename(FUELTYPE = Heat_Sys_Desc) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(cumsum = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("Location", Location, cumsum, sep = "_")

res_other
  
```

```{r}
com <- inner_join(com_other, com_fuel, by = "Location")
condo <- inner_join(condo_other, condo_fuel, by = "Location")
```

```{r}
# if four digits:
#      if first digit 0, and first three digits are NOT 013, 031, 037, or 021: remove first digit
#      else: remove last digit
# else: nothing

com <- com %>%
  mutate(USECODE = 
           ifelse(grepl("^.{4}$", USECODE),
                  ifelse(grepl("^0", USECODE) & !substr(USECODE, 1, 3) %in% c("013", "031", "037", "021"), 
                         sub("^.", "", USECODE),
                         sub(".$", "", USECODE)),
                  USECODE)
         ) %>%
  select(USECODE, FUELTYPE, AREASQ, STORYHEIGHT)

condo <- condo %>%
  mutate(USECODE = substr(USECODE, 1, 3))
```
